description: This file defines API routes for a FastAPI application managing production lines, shifts, runs, events, OEE metrics, alerts, reports, and real-time WebSocket communications for a manufacturing monitoring system.

methods.name: realtime_docs()
methods.description: Provides WebSocket usage instructions and endpoint URL.

methods.name: create_line(payload: LineCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Creates a new production line with a specified OEE target.

methods.name: list_lines(db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all production lines.

methods.name: create_shift(payload: ShiftCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Creates a new shift associated with a specific line.

methods.name: list_shifts( line_id: Optional[int] = Query(None), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Retrieves a list of shifts, optionally filtered by line.

methods.name: create_run(payload: RunCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Starts a new production run for a specific line and shift.

methods.name: end_run(run_id: int, payload: RunEnd, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
list_runs( line_id: Optional[int] = Query(None), shift_id: Optional[int] = Query(None), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Lists production runs with optional filters.

methods.name: create_event(payload: EventCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Creates a production/downtime/quality event, computes OEE, creates alerts if needed, and broadcasts updates.

methods.name: list_events( line_id: Optional[int] = Query(None), run_id: Optional[int] = Query(None), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Lists production events with optional filters.

methods.name: get_oee( run_id: int = Query(..., description="Run ID to compute OEE for."), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Computes and retrieves OEE metrics for a specific run.

methods.name: list_alerts( line_id: Optional[int] = Query(None), unacknowledged_only: bool = Query(False), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Lists alerts, optionally filtering for unacknowledged alerts.

methods.name: acknowledge_alert(alert_id: int, payload: AlertAcknowledge, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Acknowledges an alert, recording the acknowledgment timestamp.

methods.name: shift_report( line_id: int = Query(...), window_start: datetime = Query(...), window_end: datetime = Query(...), shift_id: Optional[int] = Query(None), run_id: Optional[int] = Query(None), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Generates a shift or window report based on specified parameters.

methods.name: ws_oee(websocket: WebSocket, line_id: int = Query(..., description="Line ID to subscribe to."))
methods.description: WebSocket endpoint for live OEE updates and alerts distribution.
